text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Maho, Kaori and {0}
make their way through the jungle with Illya's guidance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マホとカオリ、そして{0}は、
イリヤの案内で密林を進んでいた。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
*huff, huff*
It just gets more stuffy the further in we go...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
進めば進むほど、
なんやジメジメしたところどすなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Sunlight is proving to be a nonissue now,
but I could very much do without my clothes
feeling like they've become a part of my skin.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……日差しはだいぶ遮られているが、
この服が張り付いてくる感触は我慢ならぬぞ……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling better than ever!
This sorta heat just reminds me of back home!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は暑いのは平気さー
故郷を思い出すよー！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Reckoned you'd be used to it.
I'm havin' some real trouble just walking
'cause the ground's all squishy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
カオリはんは慣れてはんなあ。
うちはこの足元のおぼつかへん柔らかい地面も苦手やわ～……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
L-likewise!
Not to mention this obscene humidity!
It's all so distressing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
同感じゃ……！　
この水気の多い空気も、
全てが不快に感じるわい……！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: The foliage is far thicker than in times past, too.
text_block_list.orig_text: 昔よりも、木々が生い茂っておるわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: The heat must be helping it all grow big and strong.
text_block_list.orig_text:
きっと暖かいから、
すぐに成長するんだねー

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeek?!
text_block_list.orig_text: キャアアアアアッ！？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Wh-what in the world?! Did something happen?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、なんじゃ！？　
どうした！？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Th-there's a bug...
There's a bug in my clothes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
むしっ、
むしむしっ……
虫が服の中にいぃっ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
A bug? Blast...! 
There's far more where that came from, too!
Stay away! Stay away, I tell you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
虫？　
わわわっ……
いつの間に虫がこんなに……！
えぇい
わらわにまとわりつくな！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
You pesky little...!
How dare you approach me after I've swiped you away!
choice_data_list: Swat away the bugs around Illya.
text_block_list.orig_text:
このっ……
くぅっ、
振り払っても近づいてくるとはっ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Gosh! Y-you can't go touchin' me around there, my prince!
We oughtta be much, much closer before that sorta action!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やんっ！　
お、王子はん、
そんなところを触ったらあきまへん！
そういうのは、
もっと段階を踏んでからやないと！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Ouch!
Maybe you should aim for the bugs
rather than my face, you dolt!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたたっ！　
虫をはらうのはいいが、
手がわらわにも当たっておるぞ馬鹿者！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Man, you guys are overreacting.
They'll leave you alone if you stay still.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな大げささー
暴れなければなんもしてこないさー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey! There's a bunch of goya veggies over there!
I'll go get 'em!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
あそこに『ゴーヤーっぽいもの』がいっぱい生えてるさ！
ちょっと採りに行ってくるさー！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Someone, please... I'm beggin' ya!
This gal does [i]not[/i] like bugs!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひいぃんっ……
助けてーっ！　
うち、
虫は苦手どす～！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Grrr...!
Only a foolishly foolish bug would dare
hope for a morsel of my mighty blood!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くうぅっ……
このわらわから血を吸おうとするとは……！
無礼かつ命知らずな虫共じゃ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
They're gonna keep going at you if you don't stay still.
Just chill out and enjoy the vibes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人ともあんま動くと余計虫に襲われるさー
もっと気楽に構えるさー

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's there to enjoy about this?!
I-Illya! Please get this bug off my back for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
む、
無茶言わんといてーっ！
イ、
イリヤはん、
うちの背中の虫、
取っておくれやすーっ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: V-very well! Have at thee!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
任せるがよい！　
それっ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Wah hah hah!
Behold my power, you insignificant little—
text_block_list.orig_text:
わはははっ！　
どうじゃ！
わらわの手にかかれば……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Oh.
One got on your head!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
イリヤはん、
頭の上に虫がおりますえ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Hm...?
Waugh! Stay away! Stay away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……
うわあっ！？　
や、やめんかっ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Grrr...
I could wipe these little nuisances out
with a snap of my fingers if I was at full power!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くうぅっ……
わらわが全快なら
虫など一掃させてやるのに！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, troops.
I'll be back with a bunch of goya veggies in a jiffy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
もうちょっと待ってるさー
いっぱい採って、持って帰るさー

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Sh-she's awfully laid-back about this situation...
text_block_list.orig_text:
の、
のんきじゃのう、
カオリは……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho...
Phew. That should be plenty!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よいしょ、
よいしょ……
ふぅ……
このくらいあれば十分さ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait!
text_block_list.orig_text: 待たせたさー

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Quick! Let us take flight from this bug-infested hellscape!
text_block_list.orig_text:
行くぞ！　
こんなところからは
さっさとおさらばじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Wait! Don't leave poor ol' me behind!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、待って！　
うちを置いて行かんといておくれやすーっ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
*huff, huff*
That was the worst experience of my entire life...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
まったくひどい目におうたわ……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm never setting foot in a place like that again!
Y'all can be sure of it! Never, ever again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
も、
もう
二度とあんなところに行きまへん！
たとえ、
何があっても、
一生！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Good job holding out.
text_block_list.orig_text: みんなお疲れやっさー

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Now then.
What was our next objective?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁて……
次は、なんじゃったかのう？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: The plan was to find an udon rolling pin...
text_block_list.orig_text:
次は、
『うどん用麺棒』どす……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Hm...
And you're sure those aren't sold in stores?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ……
それは、街で売っているのではないか？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Udon-making ain't a popular trade in Landosol, alas...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ランドソルは、
うどん作りが
そんなに盛んやないんよ……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Udon is a dish I have yet to savor myself,
now that I think about it. More proof that
finding a rolling pin will be quite difficult, I believe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ……
確かにわらわも、
生まれてこの方、うどんは食べたことがないのう。
そうなると、
見つけるのは難しそうじゃなあ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Aww... Figured as much, but that still ain't ideal...
You reckon there's anything we can use in its place?
Somethin' long, hard, and mighty strong...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぅ……
やっぱり
そうなんやろか……
困ったわぁ。
イリヤはん、
なんかこう、
代わりになりそうなものとか
思いつかへん？
長くて、
硬くて……
強そうなやつなんやけど。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Something long and hard...
Heh... I may have just the ticket!
text_block_list.orig_text:
長くて硬い……
ふふ……
心当たりがないこともないぞ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ooh, really? Where can we find it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおーっ？　
イリヤ、
それはどこさーっ？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
My feud with the sun causes me to take refuge in
caves rather often, you see. And one in particular
is full of countless monster corpses!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わらわは日差しが苦手で、
洞窟などで休むことがあるのじゃが、
その洞窟には
魔物の亡骸が無数にあるのじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
M-monster corpses?
Sounds awfully scary, if you ask me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
魔物の亡骸どすか？　
なんや、
怖そうやなあ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Verily. From what I gather, powerful monsters
have turned it into a grave of sorts for themselves.
And among them, naturally, are the horned kind.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うむ、
どうやらその洞窟は
歴戦の魔物たちが、
最期を迎える場所になっているらしくてな、
その中には当然、
角の生えた魔物もいての。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
A cavern full of sharp, durable horns, free for the picking!
One of them should prove a suitable replacement.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その角なんかは、
とても鋭く、
同時に強固じゃ！
これなら、麺棒の代わりになると思うんじゃが。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Now [i]that[/i] sounds like a plan!
Even better if we won't have to deal with live monsters!
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに名案さー！
それに、
亡骸からだったら、
たいして苦労もしなさそうさー！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Then let us be off!
The cave in question is conveniently nearby, so follow in my stead!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうと決まれば出発じゃ！
さぁ、
わらわについてまいれ！　
洞窟はここからすぐじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With their original goal now nixed,
the crew set off to procure a monster horn.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『うどん用麺棒』をあきらめ、新たに『魔物の角』を求める一行は、
魔物の墓場である洞窟へと足を踏み入れるのだった。
